why: The opacity ladder (design/w1b-opaque-statements.md), rule string-code-unit: an astral string literal (two UTF-16 code units, outside the BMP envelope of the string model), which the model does not read, so the statement `sink("😀" + u);` is one opaque step: an uninterpreted transition keyed by its text and the same-file definitions it names, reading every local it mentions, writing every local it assigns. outside: the step unchanged and the return bound to a local, proved modulo the step. inside: `"😁"` for `"😀"` is another text, another symbol, not proved; lane B finds the difference. planted: exec/mutate.mjs's site 5 inside the step, not proved, lane B WITNESS. upstream: `n * 3` for `n * 2` changes a value only the step reads; the step takes it, so nothing is proved (LEAN_BREAK=opaque-drop-read drops that read and this unit proves falsely: the pair's break row). The construct can make a value outside the model (a boundary rule), so the step is confined to the world: escapes uses the value after it, its unit is one opaque function (the value boundary), and a reordered return there is not proved.
